data.description:
## Description

What: Three parser scripts — coderabbit-comment-parser.sh (locale-safe byte-level emoji-header matching for ⚠️/🛠️/🧹/📝, with header-drift parse_failure detection), gitar-comment-parser.sh (parses Dashboard sections with (reviewer_id, github_comment_id, row_content_hash) dedup augmentation so in-place Dashboard edits adding rows yield only new-row events), and copilot-comment-parser.sh (one event per review comment, severity=null, rule_id=null, body-derived message-hash). Each pipes through telemetry-emit.sh and is validated against the captured-output fixtures. Why: each bot's format differs; canonical events are required for cross-reviewer aggregation downstream. Scope IN: the three parsers, the per-fixture canonical-event-shape parser tests, the Gitar row_content_hash dedup augmentation. Scope OUT: the consecutive-failure escalation counter (draft-6); the bot-comment-scan adapter shell (draft-2); the live Gitar Dashboard format capture (draft-7).


## Done Definitions

- coderabbit-comment-parser.sh emits a canonical event matching the expected shape for each CodeRabbit fixture (line-anchored review comment, walkthrough, outside-diff-range) using byte-level codepoint matching robust to UTF-8 variation selectors ← Satisfies: sc-1
- gitar-comment-parser.sh against gitar-dashboard.json then gitar-dashboard-edited.json (same github_comment_id, one added row) emits only the new-row event on the second pass via (reviewer_id, github_comment_id, row_content_hash) dedup, not duplicate events for unchanged rows ← Satisfies: sc-5
- copilot-comment-parser.sh emits one canonical event per review comment with severity=null and rule_id=null and a body-derived message-hash, validated against the Copilot fixtures ← Satisfies: sc-1
- Each parser pipes its canonical event through telemetry-emit.sh and the per-fixture parser tests assert the emitted event shape ← Satisfies: sc-1

## Considerations

- [Locale] CodeRabbit emoji-header matching must use explicit codepoint sequences (byte-level), not locale-dependent string regex, to survive UTF-8 variation-selector differences.
- [Dependency] Gitar parser's row-hash strategy depends on the documented Dashboard section structure from draft-7's spike; if the spike is incomplete, parse against the gitar-dashboard fixtures and flag drift as parse_failure.

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
data.title: As a pipeline maintainer, I want per-bot comment parsers for CodeRabbit, Gitar, and Copilot that emit canonical telemetry events, so that each reviewer's findings are normalized into the shared event shape.
